page.overview:
Who is Lemons?

The Lemons are an international criminal organization that first appeared in Cars 2. They are made up of four different crime families based on their models: Gremlins (AMC Gremlin), Pacers (AMC Pacer), Hugos (Volgar Hugo) and Trunkovs (Avto Trunkov).

They are usually antagonized and mocked by other vehicles due to their odd design and weak performance in general.
